# LiveKick — Project Context & Handoff Doc
*Generated by reading the live repo at github.com/Namra1912/LiveKick (branch: main) on Aug 4, 2026. Paste this whole doc into any AI chat to get it fully up to speed before asking for changes.*

---

## 1. What LiveKick is

A dark-themed, "Operate mode" football (soccer) live-scores + fan-engagement dashboard. The core job of the app is letting a user scan match info fast — scores, live status, standings, transfers, predictions, tactics — across 5 leagues (Premier League, La Liga, Champions League, Bundesliga, Serie A). It's currently **Phase 0: frontend-only with mock data**, no live API/backend wired yet (a stub Express/MongoDB backend exists but isn't connected to the frontend).

Planned full page set (per `docs/Designs/*.png` mockups): Home Feed, Match Detail (+ Lineups + Stats), Team Profile, Player Profile, League Standings, Transfer Radar, Fan Prediction League, Tactical Lineup Lab, News & Editorial, Search Modal, Login/Signup, Player Onboarding, User Profile & Settings.

**Current focus:** get the Home Feed (route `/`) to ~95% completion before moving to the next page.

---

## 2. Tech stack

- **Frontend:** React 19 + Vite 8, plain CSS (no Tailwind runtime, despite a `tailwind.css` file existing — components use hand-written CSS files per component), `react-router-dom` v7, `lucide-react` icons, `oxlint` for linting.
- **Fonts:** self-hosted via `@fontsource` — Big Shoulders Display (display/scores), Inter (body), JetBrains Mono (timers/stats/numbers). Never load fonts via Google Fonts `<link>`.
- **Backend:** Express + MongoDB stub in `/backend` (server.js) — not currently wired to the frontend. All frontend data comes from `frontend/src/data/mockData.js`.
- **State/persistence:** No global state library. LocalStorage is used directly for a few things (favorited matches, sidebar accordion open/closed state). No React Context/Redux/Zustand.

---

## 3. Design system ("Night-Pitch") — the anti-AI-slop rules

Defined in `frontend/src/styles/tokens.css` and `.agents/AGENTS.md`. **Every new CSS should reuse these tokens, not invent new values.**

- **Background stack:** base `#080c11` → surface `#0d1520` → elevated `#111820` → hover `#18222d`. Hairline borders `#1e2a35`.
- **Text:** primary `#f1f5f9`, secondary `#94a3b8`, faint `#475569`.
- **Brand:** pitch green `#00B370` (primary accent), gold `#f59e0b` (reserved ONLY for Matchday Coins currency), live red `#f87171`.
- **Banned:** pure `#000` (except the scoreboard digit cell), pure white text, purple AI-gradients, generic slate/blue-gray defaults.
- **Radius — intentionally only 3 tiers, not arbitrary:**
  - `--radius-badge: 4px` (scoreboard digits, kickoff slots, minute badges — near-sharp)
  - `--radius-card: 14px` (double-bezel cards/containers)
  - `--radius-pill: 9999px` (segmented controls, pill buttons)
- **Double-bezel card treatment:** outer rim border + `--shadow-inset` (dark inner drop) + `--shadow-card` (outer drop) = physical depth. Favorited cards get a 3px left accent border.
- **Retro scoreboard digit:** score numbers render in individual black `#000` cells with amber glow text `#f5b942`, 4px radius, inset glow — not plain numerals in a row.
- **Restrained glows:** stadium-floodlight radial gradients belong on parent containers only, never on every card.
- **Typography:** Big Shoulders Display = scores/headings (uppercase, tight tracking). Inter = body. JetBrains Mono = all numbers/timers/stats.

## 5. What is already DONE on Home Feed (verified by reading the actual code, not assumed)

- **Sidebar** — 4 fixed/scroll regions: fixed top nav, scrollable middle, fixed bottom. **Both "My Teams" and "My Leagues" are independently collapsible accordions**, state persisted to `localStorage` (`lk_sb_teams`, `lk_sb_leagues`), smooth grid-rows collapse animation, respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Sidebar league rows** use the shared `Crest` component (real logos), reading `logoUrl` straight off the `leagues` array in `mockData.js` — no more name-lookup maps, no dead color-dot code.
- **LeagueGroup ("smart accordion")** — each of the 5 leagues always renders (none are hidden), but only auto-opens if it has matches on the selected date; empty leagues start collapsed but are still clickable to reveal a **date-aware** "No matches today/yesterday/tomorrow" message. Live-match indicator dot shown in the header when a league has a live match.
- **Real crests everywhere in the center feed** — leagues and both home/away teams render actual logo images (TheSportsDB for leagues, `luukhopman/football-logos` GitHub raw URLs for teams) via the shared `Crest` component, with a graceful deterministic-color initials-circle fallback (not a broken-image icon) if a URL 404s.
- **DateSelector** — Yesterday/Today/Tomorrow pill *plus* a full month-grid calendar popover for picking any arbitrary date, correctly syncs highlighting between the two.
- **MatchRow** — live/finished/upcoming states, live pressure bar, favorite star (persisted to `localStorage` as `lk_fav_matches`), click-through to match detail and team detail pages.
- **Live-only filter** — "Match Day Live" button in sidebar bottom toggles a dedicated live-matches-only view with its own empty state.
- **Right panel** exists with 3 widgets: Match of the Day, Fan Predictor, Trending News.

## 6. Known gaps / inconsistencies found in this pass (real issues, not guesses)

1. **Crest inconsistency in the right panel.** `MatchOfTheDayCard.jsx` still imports the *old* `TeamBadge` component from `Sidebar.jsx` (initials + hardcoded `--team-N-bg/border/text` gradient tokens) instead of the shared `Crest` component used everywhere else. Result: the right panel's featured match can visually mismatch the center feed's crest style. `PredictorCard` shows no crests at all — just plain team-name text.
2. **Dead interactive elements in NewsList.** Each news row has `role="button" tabIndex={0}` styling and the "View All" button exists, but neither has an `onClick` — clicking does nothing right now.
3. **Predictor card doesn't actually lock or persist.** `selectedVote` is local component state only (resets on refresh, not written to `localStorage`), and there's no check against `lockAt` — vote buttons stay clickable even after kickoff, when they should show a "Locked" state.
4. **Radius-token drift ("the curve boxes" issue).** `tokens.css` defines a deliberate 3-tier radius system (4px / 14px / 9999px), but at least 4 CSS files hardcode ad-hoc values *outside* that system — `Sidebar.css` (6px, 8px), `DateSelector.css` (6px, 10px), `SearchModal.css` (6px, 12px), `NewsList.css` (6px). This scattershot of in-between rounded corners is very likely the specific "AI slop" feel flagged — it breaks the intentional sharp/pill/card rhythm.
5. **"Tonight" label is hardcoded** in `MatchOfTheDayCard` regardless of the match's actual date/time.
6. **Kickoff times are shown in UTC** (`getUTCHours()`) in `MatchRow`, `PredictorCard`, and `MatchOfTheDayCard` but not labeled as UTC — consistent across the app for now, but will read as wrong local kickoff times to a real user.
7. **"Today" is anchored to the real device clock** (`new Date()`), not a fixed mock date, while mock match dates are hardcoded to fixed Aug 2026 calendar days (3rd, 4th, 5th, 8th, 15th, 22nd). It works correctly *today* (Aug 4, 2026 — 6 matches show), but as real time moves forward, "Today" will silently go empty on days with no hardcoded match (e.g. Aug 6–7, 9–14) unless mock data is periodically refreshed or dates are made relative to load time.
8. **Standings mock data is incomplete** — only Premier League and La Liga have entries in `mockData.js`'s `standings` object; Champions League, Bundesliga, and Serie A have none, so the Standings page will be empty for 3 of 5 leagues.
9. **Mock data is thin for edge-case testing** — only 12 teams, 5 leagues, ~15 matches, 4 news items. Not enough to test: a league with only 1 match, a league that's always empty, a day with 10+ matches (scroll/overflow behavior), very long team names, or multiple simultaneous live matches in one league.
10. **Not yet re-audited in this pass:** `SearchModal.jsx`, `TopNav.jsx` interactions, `PressureBar.jsx`, and all stub pages other than Standings — flagging as unverified rather than claiming they're fine.

## 7. Working conventions established with the AI pair-programmer ("Antigravity")

- Changes are shipped as **small, scoped prompts** — each prompt names the *exact files* it may touch and explicitly forbids touching anything else, to avoid breaking unrelated parts of the codebase.
- Every prompt ends with a **"HARD CONSTRAINTS"** block (file scope, no new npm packages, no dead code left behind, `prefers-reduced-motion` wrapper required on new transitions) and a **"Deliverable"** line asking the AI to confirm in code comments which task each change corresponds to.
- The user tests the output after each prompt and reports back before moving to the next item — iterate one fix at a time, don't batch unrelated fixes.
- Company/personal aesthetic bar: kill anything that reads as generic "AI slop" — arbitrary rounded corners, ungrounded gradients, decorative elements that don't serve the "Operate mode" scanning-speed goal.
